subtitle.viltrumitecore.red_hulk.enter: General Ross on the field. Stand back.
ability.viltrumitecore.red_hulk_thermal_: Claps his palms ahead: a 7-block cone, 10 damage, knockback and 3 s of fire. Every target hit adds heat. Cooldown 8 s.
ability.viltrumitecore.red_hulk_seismic_: Raises both fists and hammers the ground: a 6-block wave, 12 damage at the centre and 6 at the edge, foes are launched and stunned. +100 heat. Cooldown 12 s.
ability.viltrumitecore.red_hulk_destruct: Crouches and leaps forward. Press again in the air to dive. The landing leaves a 5-block crater: 12 damage, no fall damage. Cooldown 10 s.
ability.viltrumitecore.red_hulk_heat_bla: Needs 300+ heat. His chest glows, then a 16-block beam of heat: 7 pulses whose damage grows with heat, sets foes on fire. Spends 60 % of the heat. Press again to stop. Cooldown 15 s.
ability.viltrumitecore.red_hulk_thermal_: A roar knocks back and weakens foes within 8 blocks. 12 s of fury: +15 % damage, -15 % damage taken, +10 % speed, heat rises by itself and never cools. Cooldown 45 s.
ability.viltrumitecore.red_hulk_critical: Ultimate. Needs 700+ heat. 3 s of charging (half damage taken), then a 12-block blast: up to 30 damage, fire, foes flung away. Heat drops to zero, then 2.5 s of vulnerable recovery. Cooldown 90 s.
codex.viltrumitecore.red_hulk.name: Red Hulk
codex.viltrumitecore.red_hulk.role: General Thaddeus "Thunderbolt" Ross, a living furnace
codex.viltrumitecore.red_hulk.lore: An old soldier who got the power he hunted all his life. His body does not turn green with anger, it heats up: the longer the fight, the hotter his skin, the brighter his eyes and the harder his blows.
codex.viltrumitecore.red_hulk.gameplay: Heat gauge 0-1000: blows, combos, abilities and part of the damage taken heat the body; heat empowers his blows (up to +30 %), from 500 a heat aura burns around him. At 1000 he overheats: a steam vent, then 6 s slowed, without the heat abilities (Blast, Fury, ultimate) and taking +15 % damage. A five-hit LMB combo ending in a double-fist hammer, grab and throw on RMB, Thermal Clap, Seismic Slam, Destruction Leap, Heat Blast, Thermal Fury and the Critical Overheat ultimate. Fire and lava hurt him far less: most of that damage turns into heat.
codex.viltrumitecore.red_hulk.relations: He hunted the Hulk all his life until he became one. Captain America remembers him as a general.
